'''Pocket Monsters Zensho''' (Japanese: '''まんが版 ポケットモンスター全書''' ''Pocket Monsters Complete Book Comics Edition'') is a shōnen [[Pokémon manga]] directly based on the [[Pokémon games]]. It follows the plot of {{game|Red and Blue|s}} closer than any other Pokémon manga.

This manga covers several details that are not found in other manga or {{aniseries|PTS}}, such as the hunt for the [[Baoba|Safari Zone Warden]]'s dentures. It ends with the defeat of the [[Elite Four]].

The entire manga was released by [[Shogakukan]] in a single volume containing 10 chapters. It is written and illustrated by [[Satomi Nakamura]].

==International versions==
In {{pmin|Taiwan}}, the manga was translated by Ching Win Publishing Co., Ltd. to Traditional Chinese under the title {{tt|漫畫版 神奇寶貝全書|Manga Version: Pokémon Unabridged}}. In {{pmin|Hong Kong}}, it was translated by Hong Kong Ching Win Publishing Co., Ltd. to Traditional Chinese under the title {{tt|漫畫版 寵物小精靈全書|Manga Version: Pokémon Unabridged}}.
